description: Hand-verified capability inventory for MyExpenses (org.totschnig.myexpenses), version 4.1.0.2.

features.name: Create an account
features.description: Create an account as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: select the account type (for example cash, bank, credit card, asset, liability)

features.name: Edit or delete an account
features.description: Edit or delete an account as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: long-press the account (or open it and use the overflow menu)
tap Edit to change its properties, or tap Delete and confirm

features.name: Hide or reorder accounts
features.description: Hide or reorder accounts as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap the hide action, or use the sort option in the overflow menu to change the account ordering

features.name: View the aggregate (all accounts) balance
features.description: View the aggregate (all accounts) balance as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap the aggregate/"Total" entry for a currency
the combined transaction list and balance for all accounts in that currency are shown

features.name: Record an expense
features.description: Record an expense as documented for MyExpenses.

features.name: Record income
features.description: Record income as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: enter the amount, category and payer

features.name: Record a transfer between accounts
features.description: Record a transfer between accounts as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: enter the amount (and the equivalent amount for a different currency)

features.name: Create a split transaction
features.description: Create a split transaction as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap "Add split part" for each line and enter its amount and category
repeat until the parts add up

features.name: Use the built-in calculator for amounts
features.description: Use the built-in calculator for amounts as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap the calculator icon beside the amount field
tap the equals/confirm button to transfer the result into the amount field

features.name: Attach a picture or file to a transaction
features.description: Attach a picture or file to a transaction as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose to take a photo or select an existing file
confirm; tap the thumbnail later to view it

features.name: Scan a receipt with OCR
features.description: Scan a receipt with OCR as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: take or select the receipt image
confirm or correct the detected amount, date and payee
tap save. (Professional feature; requires the OCR engine to be configured in Settings.)

features.name: Add tags to a transaction
features.description: Add tags to a transaction as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: select existing tags or create a new one

features.name: Manage the tag list
features.description: Manage the tag list as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: long-press a tag to rename, recolour or delete it

features.name: Set the transaction status (cleared/reconciled)
features.description: Set the transaction status (cleared/reconciled) as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose uncleared, cleared or reconciled; or use the reconciliation banner in the account view

features.name: Create a template for a recurring transaction
features.description: Create a template for a recurring transaction as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap save; or open the drawer
tap "+" and fill in the details

features.name: Create a plan (schedule) for a template
features.description: Create a plan (schedule) for a template as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: set the start date and the recurrence rule
choose whether instances are created automatically or require confirmation

features.name: Apply a template manually
features.description: Apply a template manually as documented for MyExpenses.

features.name: Manage categories
features.description: Manage categories as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap "+" to create a category or subcategory
tap save; long-press an existing category to edit, move or delete it

features.name: Import a predefined category set
features.description: Import a predefined category set as documented for MyExpenses.

features.name: Manage parties (payees and payers)
features.description: Manage parties (payees and payers) as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap save; long-press to rename, merge or delete

features.name: Create and track a budget
features.description: Create and track a budget as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose the period (weekly, monthly, yearly or custom)

features.name: Review budget progress
features.description: Review budget progress as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: review the progress bars per category and the remaining amount for the period

features.name: Track debts (money lent and borrowed)
features.description: Track debts (money lent and borrowed) as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: enter the label, the party, the amount and the date
record repayments against the debt from the debt detail screen

features.name: Filter the transaction list
features.description: Filter the transaction list as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap the filter icon in the toolbar
select the criteria (category, payee, amount range, date range, transaction type, status, method, tag or free text)
apply; tap the clear action to remove the filter

features.name: Search transactions by text
features.description: Search transactions by text as documented for MyExpenses.

features.name: Group the transaction list by period
features.description: Group the transaction list by period as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose none, day, week, month or year
confirm; group headers with subtotals appear

features.name: Sort the transaction list
features.description: Sort the transaction list as documented for MyExpenses.

features.name: View the distribution chart
features.description: View the distribution chart as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Open the drawer or the account overflow menu
review the pie/bar chart of spending by category
tap a slice to drill into the subcategories

features.name: View the history chart
features.description: View the history chart as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Open the drawer or the account overflow menu
review the income, expense and balance trend chart

features.name: Print a report to PDF
features.description: Print a report to PDF as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Open an account (optionally with a filter applied)
the PDF is generated and saved or sent to the printer

features.name: Export data to CSV, QIF or JSON
features.description: Export data to CSV, QIF or JSON as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Open the account or the drawer
choose the format (CSV, QIF or JSON)
set the date range, the separator, the encoding and the handling of already-exported transactions

features.name: Import data from CSV
features.description: Import data from CSV as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: map each column to a field

features.name: Import data from QIF or other formats
features.description: Import data from QIF or other formats as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose QIF (or another supported format such as OFX or Grisbi)
choose the target account and the currency

features.name: Create a backup
features.description: Create a backup as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: optionally enable encryption and set the password

features.name: Restore from a backup
features.description: Restore from a backup as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: enter the password if it is encrypted
confirm; the current data is replaced

features.name: Schedule automatic backups
features.description: Schedule automatic backups as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: set the time and the retention

features.name: Set up cloud synchronisation
features.description: Set up cloud synchronisation as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap "+" to add a backend (for example WebDAV/Nextcloud, Dropbox or Google Drive)
enter the credentials or complete the OAuth flow

features.name: Protect the app with a password or the device lock
features.description: Protect the app with a password or the device lock as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose password protection or device lock (screen lock/biometrics)
configure the delay and whether the account balances are hidden

features.name: Manage currencies and exchange rates
features.description: Manage currencies and exchange rates as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: tap a currency to set its symbol and number of fraction digits
configure the exchange-rate provider and download rates where supported

features.name: Add a home screen widget
features.description: Add a home screen widget as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the required widget (for example the template, account balance or quick-expense widget) onto the home screen

features.name: Configure the user interface
features.description: Configure the user interface as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: set the theme (light, dark or system), the font size, the language, the grouping default, whether the running balance is shown and the home screen summary options

features.name: Configure transaction entry defaults
features.description: Configure transaction entry defaults as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: set options such as the default transaction type, whether the time is recorded, auto-fill of amount and category from the payee, and the default method

features.name: Manage payment methods
features.description: Manage payment methods as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: enter the label and select the applicable account types

features.name: Reset an account (delete its transactions)
features.description: Reset an account (delete its transactions) as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: choose whether to export the transactions first and whether to keep the opening balance

features.name: Upgrade to a paid tier
features.description: Upgrade to a paid tier as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: complete the in-app purchase or enter a licence key

features.name: Open help and the FAQ
features.description: Open help and the FAQ as documented for MyExpenses.
actions: Open Settings or the overflow menu
read the in-app help pages or open the online FAQ. ## **Category: File management**
